Compare expected growth with resource costs and available funding.
Shared definitions of MRR or ARR, churn, margins and budget variances. Data and comments for the board are prepared together.
Explain performance without confusing contracted revenue, invoicing and collections.

faq: How does a Fractional CFO address startup needs?

The arrangement provides part-time finance leadership. Startup needs include growth assumptions, cash consumption, financing and investor expectations. For SaaS, this also includes consistent recurring revenue data.
Can we keep our accountant?
Yes. Scoping distinguishes accounting production, data reconciliation and financial management. The CFO works with your firm and teams; included work and contacts are specified in the contract.
Do you support startups before their first funding round?
Needs are assessed according to decisions and available data. A focused modelling project may be more appropriate than recurring support. No funding stage automatically requires a Fractional CFO.
What should we prepare for the first conversation?
Organization, deadlines, recent accounts, budget and key indicators. For SaaS, identify invoicing and subscription tools. Secure sharing of detailed documents is agreed afterwards.
What timing and availability should we expect?

Starting depends on the available profile, scope and access. Iter’s indicative range is 1 to 8 days per month, without a guaranteed day package. Review frequency, urgent requests and initial deliverables are agreed together.
What commitment applies to recurring support?
Iter provides monthly support without a minimum term, with 30 days’ notice. The contract specifies scope and additional projects. One-off work is agreed separately.

Fractional CFO describes finance leadership provided outside a salaried role. Part-time work is its recurring arrangement, with planned interventions. An interim CFO addresses a temporary need for continuity or transformation.
How many days should we plan for?
The indicative Iter range is 1 to 8 days per month. It depends on entities, tools, deadlines and work carried out internally. Headcount alone is insufficient to determine it.
Do we need to change accountants?
Not necessarily. Scoping identifies the accounting firm’s work, expected data and the CFO’s role. Clear coordination avoids duplication.
Can we hire a CFO afterwards?
Yes. The engagement can prepare the handover of tools, assumptions and calendars to an internal hire. Handover needs to be included in the scope.
What commitment is required?
Iter pricing provides for monthly support without a minimum term, terminable with 30 days’ notice. Services and changes to scope are recorded in the contract.

faq: Which indicators should we monitor?
Those that support your decisions: revenue, margin, costs, cash flow or operational indicators, depending on the activity. Definitions and sources need to be agreed before building a dashboard.
Can you work with our current tools?
Scoping examines exports, access and tool limitations. Migration is not automatic; it needs to be justified by needs, costs and the team’s ability to maintain the arrangement.
Do we need real-time reporting?
Frequency depends on the decision and data availability. Weekly cash monitoring or monthly margin reviews may be more relevant than a continuously displayed but incomplete picture.
How does this differ from a part-time CFO?
Management control focuses on budgets, costs, margins and reporting. The CFO also covers broader financial decisions, cash flow, financing and coordination of the finance function.

faq: Are preparation and due diligence the same engagement?
No. Preparing a file organizes and explains information. An independent review examines it for its recipients under a separate assignment.
Can you support the buyer?
The scope can include financial review of available target data, issues to watch and analyses relevant to negotiations. Conditions are defined during scoping.
Which documents are needed?
Accounts, reporting, schedules, customer and supplier data, forecasts and documents supporting key items. The list is adapted to the transaction and assignment.
